title: Home Oxygen Therapy Patient Travel Terms
content:
# Patient Travel Terms — Home Oxygen Therapy

## Travel inside the service area

A Home Oxygen Therapy patient traveling inside the Summit Ridge service area receives a travel supply delivery of up to the class's in-area travel supply days of extra portable supply, at no charge.

A travel supply is delivered only once a travel arrangement request on this oxygen record is approved. The basis is the system record: the request type, its status, its travel start date and the oxygen record it is filed on.

## Travel outside the service area

For travel outside the service area Summit Ridge arranges a partner supplier at the destination on a travel arrangement request received at least the class's notice figure in business days before the travel start date, for a stay of no more than the class's longest partner stay in days. The partner is paid by Summit Ridge, and nothing is billed to the patient or the coverage for it. A longer stay is a relocation, not travel.

## Air travel

Only a class whose portable unit is airline approved may be carried on an aircraft; cylinders and liquid never fly.

## Summary table

| Situation | Term |
|---|---|
| In-area travel | travel supply of up to the class's in-area days, no charge; delivered only once a travel arrangement request on this record is approved |
| Out-of-area travel | partner supplier arranged on a request received at least the notice figure in business days before the travel start date, for a stay of no more than the longest partner stay |
| Cost of the partner supplier | paid by Summit Ridge; nothing billed to the patient or the coverage |
| Out-of-area stay longer than the longest partner stay | a relocation, not travel |
| Carrying the unit on an aircraft | only a class whose portable unit is airline approved; cylinders and liquid never fly |

## Hypothetical illustration

A request received 12 business days before a hypothetical travel start date meets a notice figure of 10 business days; one received 8 business days before does not.
